messages:
Marie (Product): Quick RN + internal announce plan for tomorrow's deploy. TL;DR: runtime patch for batching heuristics (no API/schema change). Need an ops-ambassador and someone to sign the rollback criteria.
Sam (Eng Release): Copy notes below — keeping exec one-liner & ops checklist. Will pin copy by EOD.
Sam (Eng Release): 1) One-line for exec: 'Performance tuning update to reduce token cost by ~8% with no API changes.' 2) Audience: all engineers + CS/Support + SRE. 3) Release notes: short bullet list + link to post-deploy metrics.
Alex (Oncall): I can be ops-ambassador for the 2h window (10:00–12:00 PT). I’ll monitor canary and be the single pager contact.
Jen (SRE): +1 Alex. Can you own rollback decision up to 11:30? After that, I'll take over if we see regression.
Alex (Oncall): Yep — I’ll call rollback if latency p50 rises >30% vs baseline or error-rate >0.5% for 3 consecutive minutes.
Sam (Eng Release): Noted. Can we add an automated alert to the release channel for those thresholds?
Jen (SRE): I’ll add a short pager rule and a channel alert. Pager policy: page SRE on true-positive; otherwise post-only.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] scheduled deploy: repo=runtime-service ref=release/2026-03-batch-tweak image=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:2026-03-08-rc3 window=10:00-12:00 PT canary=10% rollout=gradual
Marie (Product): Copy draft for internal blast (keep short): "Starting 10:00 PT we’ll roll a runtime performance patch to improve batching. Expected impact: lower token cost and slight latency variance during canary. No API changes. Ops contact: @Alex (Oncall)."
Sam (Eng Release): I'll post that + link to the RN doc. Also attaching the short checklist we want pinned under the thread:
Sam (Eng Release): ```Checklist:
- Pin version: runtime:2026-03-08-rc3
- Canary: 10% for min 15m with <0.5% errors
- Rollback triggers: p50 +30% OR errors >0.5% sustained 3m
- Oncall rota: Alex (10:00-11:30), Jen (11:30-12:30)
- Post-metrics: token cost change and p50/p95 latency
- Postmortem owner if rolled back: Eng runtime lead
```
Jen (SRE): Suggest adding 'DB-related latency check' to rollback triggers. If we see DB amplification, automatic rollback.
Alex (Oncall): Good call. Add: DB tail-latency p95 > 200ms for 3m => immediate rollback.
Sam (Eng Release): Updated checklist posted. I'll pin it to the channel and include in the internal announce.
Marie (Product): One more ask: legal/security review confirmed no compliance impact, right?
Jen (SRE): Confirmed — no new telemetry or storage. Security ok.
Alex (Oncall): Quick preflight run: I'll run smoke against staging at 08:30 PT and paste results here. If green, we proceed.
deploy-bot: [deploybot] preflight run requested by Alex (Oncall) — job=smoke-staging-2026-03-08 status=queued
Sam (Eng Release): Timing for internal blast: 09:15 PT — gives CS/Support heads time to review before window.
Marie (Product): Perfect. Final: Alex ops-ambassador, Jen rollback standby, Sam to post RN + pin, I’ll draft exec one-liner. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Alex (Oncall): I’ll post smoke results by 08:40 and standby at 09:00.
Jen (SRE): I’ll monitor alerts and be ready to take over rollback at 11:30.
Sam (Eng Release): Pin done — link: https://docs.internal/redwood/release-notes/runtime-2026-03-08-rc3 (will be in blast)
Marie (Product): Aiming to keep internal announce two lines + checklist link. Minimal noise.
Alex (Oncall): Acknowledged. If rollback happens, we’ll use the standard rollback playbook and ping #incident-start.
Marie (Product): Closing the loop — will send final pre-deploy notice at 09:15 PT. Everyone in this thread = aware.
Sam (Eng Release): Thanks — posting RN + pin in 10.
Jen (SRE): Thanks team.
Marie (Product): :white_check_mark:
